messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
5.3 Whether the proposal form proposed to be used for this product is already filed Yes / No 5.4 If Yes, furnish the Unique Reference Number of the Proposal Form 5.5 If No, attach the proposal form afresh as per the applicable provisions of Product Filing procedure. Section VI - Distribution Channels 6 Distribution channels: 6.1 Specify the various distribution channels to be used for distributing the product- [reply shall be specific and cannot refer to the replies like “as approved by IRDAI”] 6.1 Commission scales to distribution channels— specify the rates which are to be paid-[reply shall be specific] S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 6.2 Expected proportions of business to be procured by each channel shall be indicated for the next 5 years.
"""

Passage B:
"""
These documents are also fully in compliance with the underwriting and rating policy approved by the Board of Directors of the insurer. 4. The statements made in the filing Form IRDAI –HIP are true and correct. Date: Signature of Principal Officer or Designated Officer Place: Name and designation along with Company’s seal Certificate by Product Management Committee (to be issued by PMC and retained by the insurer) 1. This is to certify that: a. The PMC has reviewed the objective of introducing the product, target customers, suitability of the product in the market. b. The product is fully compliant with insurance principles, regulatory requirements. c. The prospectus and sales literature provide all the details based on which the prospect/customer can take an informed decision. d.
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What information must be provided about the proposal form for the product, and how does the PMC certification confirm its compliance with regulatory requirements?","answer":"The insurer must state whether the proposal form has already been filed and, if so, provide its Unique Reference Number; if not, a fresh proposal form must be attached. The PMC certification confirms that the product, including its proposal form, complies with insurance principles and regulatory requirements.","facts_a":["Whether the proposal form proposed to be used for this product is already filed","If Yes, furnish the Unique Reference Number of the Proposal Form","If No, attach the proposal form afresh as per the applicable provisions of Product Filing procedure"],"facts_b":["The statements made in the filing Form IRDAI –HIP are true and correct","The PMC has reviewed the objective of introducing the product, target customers, suitability of the product in the market","The product is fully compliant with insurance principles, regulatory requirements"],"sub_queries":["proposal form filed unique reference number","PMC certification compliance"]}]}
